description: This file defines the tlKeyword class for managing keywords within the TestLink project, including database interactions, XML/CSV serialization, and keyword validation.

classes.name: tlKeyword
classes.description: A class supporting management, serialization, and database operations for keywords in TestLink.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns a string representation of an error code.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the keyword object with database ID, test project ID, name, and notes.

methods.name: readFromDB
methods.description: Reads a keyword from the database into the object.

methods.name: readFromDBRow
methods.description: Populates the object from a database row.

methods.name: getReadFromDBQuery
methods.description: Constructs a SQL query to read keywords by IDs.

methods.name: writeToDB
methods.description: Saves the keyword object into the database.

methods.name: checkKeyword
methods.description: Validates the keyword's name and checks for duplicates.

methods.name: deleteFromDB
methods.description: Deletes the keyword and related entries from the database.

methods.name: getByID
methods.description: Creates a keyword object from the database by ID.

methods.name: getByIDs
methods.description: Creates multiple keyword objects from the database by IDs.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to retrieve all keywords.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns an array of the keyword's properties.

methods.name: checkKeywordName
methods.description: Validates the syntax of a keyword name.

methods.name: doesKeywordExist
methods.description: Checks if a keyword with the same name exists in the test project.

methods.name: getFormatDescriptionForXML
methods.description: Provides an XML format description for exporting.

methods.name: writeToXML
methods.description: Serializes the keyword to XML.

methods.name: toXMLString
methods.description: Returns the XML string representation of the keyword.

methods.name: readFromXML
methods.description: Reads a keyword from an XML string.

methods.name: readFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Populates the object from a SimpleXML element.

methods.name: getFormatDescriptionForCSV
methods.description: Provides CSV format description.

methods.name: writeToCSV
methods.description: Serializes the keyword to CSV.

methods.name: readFromCSV
methods.description: Populates the object from a CSV string.

methods.name: getSimpleSet
methods.description: Retrieves a simplified set of keywords from the database.
